abstract: We examine non-underwritten placements of seasoned equity made by publicly traded firms and contrast non-intermediated and intermediated deals. We posit that agent-assisted, intermediated placements indicate relative weakness, whereas healthier firms place their equity directly with investors. Indeed, the market reaction to announcements of non-intermediated (intermediated) placements of equity is significantly positive (negative). Our findings are robust to selection and simultaneity checks. On average, non-intermediated offerings are placed at a premium and exhibit significantly better long-run stock performance. We also examine the role of the information environment provided by analysts and the coverage by agent-affiliated analysts in private placements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了上市公司进行的非承销定向增发，并对比了非中介化与中介化交易。我们假设，由代理人协助的中介化定向增发表明企业相对弱势，而更健康的企业则直接向投资者配售股票。确实，市场对非中介化（中介化）股权配售公告的反应显著为正（负）。我们的发现在选择性和同时性检验中依然稳健。平均而言，非中介化发行以溢价配售，并展现出显著更优的长期股票表现。我们还考察了分析师提供的信息环境以及代理人关联分析师在私募配售中的覆盖作用。
title: Non-underwritten placements of equity
title_zh: 非承销式股权配售

abstract: The Taylor principle, a more than one-for-one reaction of the nominal interest rate to inflation, is a central tenet of monetary policy to rule out self-fulfilling equilibria. The standard sticky-price model only holds this principle as a sufficient determinacy bound, with substitutes such as output-gap targeting available. We show that if the long-run Phillips curve is vertical, the Taylor principle is necessary and no amount of output-gap, output-growth, or forecast targeting can substitute for the vigorous response to inflation it prescribes. Sticky price models report determinacy bounds as generically model-dependent, nonlinear functions of model parameters. We find that models with vertical long-run Phillips curves share the same determinacy bounds despite differing short-run tradeoffs. These bounds are more conservative, placing tighter restrictions on monetary policy, and more robust, being independent of model-specific parameters and depending solely on monetary policy’s reaction to current inflation.
abstract_zh: 泰勒原理，即名义利率对通胀的响应超过一比一，是货币政策排除自我实现均衡的核心原则。标准粘性价格模型仅将此原则视为充分确定性边界，并提供了如产出缺口目标等替代方案。我们证明，若长期菲利普斯曲线垂直，则泰勒原理为必要条件，且任何产出缺口、产出增长或预测目标均无法替代其规定的对通胀的强力响应。粘性价格模型将确定性边界报告为通常依赖模型、随模型参数变化的非线性函数。我们发现，具有垂直长期菲利普斯曲线的模型，尽管短期权衡不同，却共享相同的确定性边界。这些边界更为保守，对货币政策施加更严格的限制，且更为稳健，不依赖于模型特定参数，仅取决于货币政策对当前通胀的反应。
title: Informational Inertia and the Taylor Principle
title_zh: 信息惯性及泰勒原理

abstract: Peer-confirming equilibrium (Lipnowski and Sadler, 2019) weakens Nash equilibrium: given a network, each player correctly anticipates only her neighbors’ actions. We relate the two in anchor games, in which one player—the anchor—is indifferent among her actions, while every other player’s unique best response varies one-to-one with the anchor’s action. We show that peer-confirming equilibrium coincides with Nash equilibrium if and only if the network is connected. Even when a neighbor’s action is payoff-irrelevant, so long as it reveals the action of a payoff-relevant player, that information is transmitted exactly across any distance.
abstract_zh: 同伴确认均衡（Lipnowski和Sadler，2019）弱化了纳什均衡：给定一个网络，每位玩家仅正确预期其邻居的行动。我们在锚定博弈中探讨两者的关系，其中一位玩家——锚定者——对其行动无差异，而其他每位玩家的唯一最优反应随锚定者的行动一一变化。我们证明，同伴确认均衡与纳什均衡一致，当且仅当网络是连通的。即使邻居的行动与收益无关，只要它揭示了收益相关玩家的行动，该信息便能精确地跨越任意距离传递。
title: Peer-confirming equilibrium in anchor games
title_zh: 锚定博弈中的同伴确认均衡

abstract: This paper examines how natural disasters complicate government efforts to balance energy security with the energy transition in regulated electricity systems. Using random variations in runoff as a natural experiment, we find that droughts lead to a long-term expansion of coal-fired power capacity. This expansion is reflected in extensive-margin adjustments, particularly through the commissioning of new coal-fired power plants. We also show that, under administrative regulation of electricity trading and generation, this investment response is driven primarily by government efforts to strengthen power supply stability rather than by firms’ profit-seeking incentives alone. Our findings highlight how adaptive responses to climate-related supply shocks can generate long-lasting fossil-fuel legacies in developing countries where electricity markets are not yet fully developed.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在受监管的电力系统中，自然灾害如何使政府在平衡能源安全与能源转型之间的努力复杂化。利用径流量的随机变化作为自然实验，我们发现干旱导致燃煤发电能力的长期扩张。这种扩张体现在集约边际调整上，尤其是通过新建燃煤电厂来实现。我们还表明，在电力交易和发电受到行政监管的情况下，这一投资反应主要源于政府加强电力供应稳定性的努力，而非仅由企业逐利动机驱动。我们的研究结果凸显了，在电力市场尚未完全成熟的发展中国家，对气候相关供应冲击的适应性反应可能产生持久的化石燃料遗留效应。

abstract: Abstract Zoning reform is increasingly advocated to redress unaffordable housing, but few real‐world examples demonstrate its efficacy. However, Auckland recently upzoned approximately three‐quarters of its residential land, precipitating a housing construction boom. We investigate whether the reform reduced housing costs, adopting a synthetic control method to estimate rental prices in Auckland under the counterfactual of no zoning change. Eight years after the reform, the synthetic control under our preferred empirical specification implies that rents decreased by 23% due to the reform. These findings are robust across a range of specifications and support the proposition that widespread upzoning can enhance housing affordability.
abstract_zh: 摘要 分区改革日益被倡导以解决住房负担能力问题，但很少有现实案例证明其有效性。然而，奥克兰最近对其约四分之三的住宅用地进行了重新分区，引发了住房建设热潮。我们采用合成控制法，在未发生分区变化的反事实情境下估算奥克兰的租金价格，以研究该改革是否降低了住房成本。改革实施八年后，我们偏好的实证设定下的合成控制结果表明，租金因改革下降了23%。这些发现在一系列设定下均保持稳健，并支持了广泛重新分区可提升住房可负担性的论点。
title: Can zoning reform reduce housing costs? Evidence from rents in Auckland
title_zh: 分区改革能否降低住房成本？来自奥克兰租金的证据

abstract: A large body of research has established the empirical and quantitative importance of international remittances as an insurance mechanism against income shocks in developing countries. However, households have additional self-insurance mechanisms, including precautionary savings, labor supply adjustments, and multiple earners. This paper develops a model with heterogeneous two-member households and endogenous international remittances to study the relationship between remittances from overseas workers and other self-insurance mechanisms. I calibrate the model with data from the Dominican Republic, and then use the model to decompose the relative importance of the self-insurance mechanisms used by non-migrant households and households with overseas workers. I find that the response of household behavior (remittances, labor supply, and savings) differs greatly depending on whether the household has an overseas worker or is a non-migrant household and on whether the shock hits the overseas worker (usually male) or the left-behind family member (usually female). Allowing for correlated wage shocks within non-migrant households further highlights the insurance benefits of migration by reducing joint exposure to local shocks and altering the composition of self-insurance mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 大量研究已确立国际汇款作为发展中国家收入冲击保险机制的经验与定量重要性。然而，家庭还拥有其他自我保险机制，包括预防性储蓄、劳动供给调整以及多收入来源。本文构建了一个包含异质性双成员家庭和内生国际汇款的模型，以研究海外工人汇款与其他自我保险机制之间的关系。我利用多米尼加共和国的数据对模型进行校准，然后使用该模型分解非移民家庭和拥有海外工人的家庭所采用的自我保险机制的相对重要性。研究发现，家庭行为（汇款、劳动供给和储蓄）的反应差异显著，取决于家庭是否拥有海外工人或为非移民家庭，以及冲击是作用于海外工人（通常为男性）还是留守家庭成员（通常为女性）。允许非移民家庭内部工资冲击相关，进一步凸显了移民通过减少对本地冲击的共同暴露和改变自我保险机制构成所带来的保险收益。

title: International Remittances and Intra-Household Risk-Sharing

abstract: Does proximity to the natal family protect women against intimate partner violence (IPV)? Leveraging Uzbekistan as a natural laboratory and an original list experiment among 835 married women, we find that women near their parents show a list-experiment prevalence estimate of 9.4% and no detectable reporting gap, whereas those far from their parents report only 8.5% in direct surveys, against a list-experiment estimate of 36.2%. Standard surveys do not merely undercount these victims — they invert the ranking of risk, making the most vulnerable women appear the safest. A parallel attitude experiment supports neither preference falsification nor cultural selection.
abstract_zh: 靠近原生家庭能否保护女性免受亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）侵害？以乌兹别克斯坦为自然实验场，通过对835名已婚女性开展原始列表实验，我们发现：与父母同住的女性在列表实验中遭受暴力的估计比例为9.4%，且未发现可检测的报告偏差；而远离父母的女性在直接调查中仅报告8.5%的暴力发生率，但列表实验估计值却高达36.2%。传统调查不仅低估了这些受害者的数量——更彻底颠倒了风险排序，使最脆弱的女性反而显得最安全。平行态度实验的结果既不支持偏好伪装假说，也不支持文化选择假说。
title: Under the wing: The effect of parental proximity on intimate partner violence and underreporting
title_zh: 庇护之下：父母邻近性对亲密伴侣暴力及其低报率的影响

abstract: This note studies a pure fertility-timing reform in a three-period OLG model. Holding completed fertility fixed, shifting births from middle age to youth raises the balanced-growth factor if N > 1 , lowers it if N < 1 , and leaves it unchanged if N = 1 . The same positive balanced-growth root λ determines cohort growth, the cohort ratio, and the steady-state PAYG support ratio λ 2 + λ . Thus the long-run support-ratio effect, and under an exogenous wage the pension-benefit effect, are positive in growing populations and negative in shrinking ones.
abstract_zh: 本文在三期OLG模型中研究了一项纯粹的生育时机改革。在保持终身生育率不变的前提下，将生育行为从中年阶段提前至青年阶段，若N>1则会提高平衡增长因子，若N<1则会降低该因子，若N=1则保持不变。相同的正平衡增长根λ决定了队列增长、队列比率以及稳态现收现付制抚养比λ²+λ。因此，长期抚养比效应以及在外生工资条件下的养老金待遇效应，在人口增长型社会中为正，在人口收缩型社会中为负。
title: Birth timing, stable population growth, and pay-as-you-go pensions
title_zh: 生育时机、稳定人口增长与现收现付养老金

abstract: This paper provides novel firm-level estimates of the economic damages caused by temperature shocks to European firms. I rely on a panel data analysis to show wide heterogeneities in the impact of temperature shocks, which depend on firm characteristics. This paper reveals the importance of micro-level data for quantifying climate damages estimates, as the average relationship between temperature and economic outcomes masks firms’ different susceptibilities to weather shocks. These create both winners and losers, harming less productive firms, particularly those in warmer regions, while benefiting more productive ones. Compared with the pooled marginal effect, the least-productive firms experience negative effects roughly ten times as large, while the most-productive firms experience positive effects roughly three times as large. I highlight the distributional effects of climate change, and offer insights for adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于温度冲击对欧洲企业造成经济损失的新型企业层面估计。我采用面板数据分析，揭示了温度冲击影响的广泛异质性，这种异质性取决于企业特征。本文揭示了微观数据在量化气候损害估计中的重要性，因为温度与经济结果之间的平均关系掩盖了企业对天气冲击的不同敏感性。这既创造了赢家也创造了输家，损害了生产率较低的企业（尤其是位于较暖地区的企业），同时使生产率较高的企业受益。与合并边际效应相比，生产率最低的企业受到的负面效应大约是其十倍，而生产率最高的企业获得的正面效应大约是其三倍。我强调了气候变化的分配效应，并为适应政策提供了见解。

title: Heterogeneous effects of weather shocks on firm economic performance

abstract: The social capital embedded in peers' parents can be a hidden but powerful force shaping adolescent development. This study investigates how peers from civil servant families impact adolescents' noncognitive outcomes within the same classroom. Using nationally representative data on middle school students in China and leveraging random classroom assignment, we find that greater exposure to classmates from civil servant families improves students' noncognitive skills, and is associated with higher friendship network quality and stronger teacher-student relationships. These positive effects are especially significant among boys, rural backgrounds, and low-SES households. Our findings contribute novel evidence on the role of peer social capital in influencing children's human capital development.
abstract_zh: 同伴家长所嵌入的社会资本，可能是一种隐蔽却强大的力量，塑造着青少年的发展。本研究探讨了同班同学中来自公务员家庭的学生如何影响青少年的非认知能力结果。利用中国全国代表性的初中生数据，并借助随机分班的自然实验，我们发现，与来自公务员家庭的同学接触越多，学生的非认知技能越高，且与更高的友谊网络质量和更强的师生关系相关联。这些积极效应在男生、农村背景及低社会经济地位家庭中尤为显著。我们的研究为同伴社会资本在影响儿童人力资本发展中的作用提供了新颖的证据。

abstract: Land use optimization is a crucial method to reduce carbon emission and promote sustainable development, calling for advanced fine-grained modeling to address complex human-land conflicts. However, existing models still exhibit limitations in internalizing geographical rules, constructing multi-level interaction mechanisms, and bridging the spatial-scale mismatch between global and local optimization. Therefore, this study constructs a multi-objective optimization scenario under low-carbon development, proposing a novel coupling model (SSFLA-MLAS), which integrates a spatialized shuffled frog leaping algorithm (SSFLA) with a multi-level agent system (MLAS). The integration resolves cross-scale spatial coordination through a nested coupling architecture, while simultaneously accounting for multi-level interactive decision simulation and multi-objective heuristic search. The case study in Huangpi District demonstrates that: (1) SSFLA-MLAS outperforms single algorithms in effectiveness and efficiency, achieving overall objective 3.4%, 32.5% and 26.5% greater than SSFLA, MLAS and multi-agent system (MAS). (2) MLAS improves the comprehensive landscape pattern index by 26.4% over MAS while aligning spatial layouts with development strategies. (3) SSFLA-MLAS demonstrates remarkable optimization results, improving economic, social and ecological objectives by 5.01%, 2.87% and 0.74%, while enhancing net carbon sink by 1.38%. The model not only offers intelligent support for sustainable land-use planning, but also advances the methodological integration of spatial optimization modeling through coupling global search with local simulation. abstract: This paper explores the recent developments in urban allotment gardens (UAGs) in Czechia, situating them within ongoing debates in urban planning across Central and Eastern Europe. Responding to increasing pressures on urban land, the study has two main goals: (1) to identify key trends in urban gardening, and (2) to develop a typology of UAGs relevant for local authorities. The research focused on diverse cities—Uherské Hradiště, Opava, Olomouc, and Ostrava—using geospatial methods, including historical and recent aerial imagery and orthophotographs, together with field research, to analyse the characteristics and development patterns of UAGs over time. We selected various UAGs and examined their features, such as location, size, plot count, and land-use patterns. Our findings led to the identification of four main types of UAGs: production-oriented (with at least 50% productive area), mixed production-recreation (with 25–45% dedicated to production, 25–55% to recreation), mainly recreation with housing potential (over 60% recreation area), and climate-adaptive (with at least 50% nature-recreation space). The findings reveal a common presence of mixed production-recreation UAGs, which tend to shift from food production to recreational or residential use. These trends are influenced by factors such as urban location, land ownership, planning policies, and gardening practices. The paper contributes to European debates on sustainable urban land management by critically examining the role of urban gardening in planning and providing evidence-based recommendations for local authorities.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了捷克城市 allotment 花园（UAGs）的最新发展，并将其置于中欧与东欧城市规划的持续讨论背景之中。面对城市土地日益增长的压力，本研究有两个主要目标：（1）识别城市园艺的关键趋势；（2）为地方政府制定一套与UAGs相关的类型学。研究聚焦于多样化的城市——乌赫尔堡、奥帕瓦、奥洛穆茨和俄斯特拉发，采用地理空间方法，包括历史和近期航拍影像及正射影像，结合实地调研，分析UAGs随时间变化的特征和发展模式。我们选取了多种UAGs，并考察了其位置、规模、地块数量及土地利用模式等特征。研究结果识别出四种主要类型的UAGs：生产导向型（生产面积至少占50%）、生产与休闲混合型（生产面积占25%–45%，休闲面积占25%–55%）、以休闲为主且具备住房潜力型（休闲面积超过60%），以及气候适应型（自然休闲空间至少占50%）。研究发现，生产与休闲混合型UAGs普遍存在，并倾向于从食品生产转向休闲或居住用途。这些趋势受城市区位、土地所有权、规划政策及园艺实践等因素的影响。本文通过批判性审视城市园艺在规划中的作用，并为地方政府提供基于证据的建议，为欧洲关于可持续城市土地管理的讨论做出了贡献。

abstract: Integrated staple food markets are essential for food security in sub-Saharan Africa, where national production is often sufficient but spatial disparities limit access for households in deficit regions. This study examines price connectedness in maize and yam markets across ten major regions in Ghana and assesses how transmission patterns respond to domestic and global shocks. Using monthly wholesale prices from January 2006 to December 2024, we employ a dynamic Quantile Vector Autoregression framework to estimate spillovers across the full distribution of price movements. The results show strong integration in maize markets, with total dynamic connectedness averaging 92 %. Major assembly and transit markets, including Kumasi, Techiman and Bolgatanga, consistently transmit price shocks, while coastal consumption markets such as Accra and Takoradi receive them. Yam markets exhibit weaker and more variable integration, with an average connectedness of 87 % and a more dispersed structure of price leadership across regions. For both commodities, connectedness strengthened during the 2008 food price hikes, whereas connectedness during the COVID-19 period was uneven and volatile. In contrast, political regime changes in 2009 and 2017 do not generate substantial shifts in market connectedness, highlighting the dominant role of structural supply chains and trader coordination over short-term political events. The findings identify regional markets where households face greater exposure to price volatility and highlight the importance of spatially targeted investments in transport, storage and market coordination alongside measures to manage shock transmission and reduce vulnerability to price volatility and unequal food access.
abstract_zh: 一体化主食市场对于撒哈拉以南非洲的粮食安全至关重要，该地区国家层面的产量往往充足，但空间差异限制了缺粮区域家庭的获取能力。本研究考察了加纳十个主要地区玉米和山药市场的价格关联性，并评估了传导模式如何响应国内及全球冲击。利用2006年1月至2024年12月的月度批发价格数据，我们采用动态分位数向量自回归框架，估计价格变动全分布上的溢出效应。结果显示，玉米市场整合程度较高，总动态关联度平均为92%。主要集散和转运市场，包括库马西、特奇曼和博尔加坦加，持续传导价格冲击，而阿克拉和塔科拉迪等沿海消费市场则接收这些冲击。山药市场表现出较弱且波动较大的整合特征，平均关联度为87%，且区域间价格领导结构更为分散。就两种商品而言，关联度在2008年食品价格飙升期间有所增强，而在COVID-19期间则呈现不均衡且波动的态势。相比之下，2009年和2017年的政治政权更迭并未引发市场关联度的显著变化，凸显了结构性供应链和交易商协调相对于短期政治事件的支配作用。研究结果识别了家庭面临更大价格波动风险的区域市场，并强调了在交通、仓储和市场协调方面进行空间定向投资的重要性，同时需采取措施管理冲击传导，以降低价格波动脆弱性和粮食获取不平等。
title: Market connectedness and price spillovers in Ghanaian maize and yam markets: Implications for food security
title_zh: 加纳玉米与山药市场的市场关联性与价格溢出效应：对粮食安全的启示

abstract: Why might persuaders favor anecdotes over aggregate statistics? We study a policy advocate choosing between them to persuade a diverse, skeptical citizenry with demographically correlated outcomes. Two forces compete: an umbrella effect, by which everyone responds more strongly to the statistic, and a wild-card effect, by which the anecdote's higher variance makes favorable realizations likelier. The anecdote prevails under sufficiently narrow consensus, so its appeal has a rational, informational basis. When breadth of aggregation is flexible, the optimal evidence is a local statistic that aggregates over a broader subpopulation than the minimal winning coalition, though almost anecdotal as consensus narrows.
abstract_zh: 为何说服者更偏爱轶事而非总体统计数据？我们研究了一位政策倡导者在两者间的选择，其目标是说服一个具有人口统计相关结果的多元化、持怀疑态度的公民群体。两种效应相互竞争：一是“伞效应”，即每个人对统计数据的反应更为强烈；二是“野牌效应”，即轶事的高方差使得有利结果更可能出现。当共识足够狭窄时，轶事占据上风，因此其吸引力具有理性的信息基础。当聚合范围灵活时，最优证据是一种局部统计量，它聚合了比最小获胜联盟更广泛的子群体，但随着共识变窄，这种统计量几乎接近于轶事。
title: Anecdotes or Statistics?
title_zh: 轶事还是统计数据？

abstract: As demand for critical minerals accelerates with the energy transition, artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) has emerged as a key but poorly understood source of supply. We construct the first continental-scale panel of mining activity in Sub-Saharan Africa by applying supervised deep-learning methods to satellite imagery, identifying over 50,000 mining sites across 39 countries and reconstructing monthly activity from 2000 to 2019. We document three main findings. First, mining location follows strong market-access gradients with pronounced non-linearities: proximity to ports raises mining probability within 200 km, but this premium reverses at intermediate distances and re-emerges only in the most remote areas -- consistent with distance from urban centers proxying for weaker state reach and lower monitoring of informal activity. Second, entry responds rapidly to commodity price shocks, indicating that ASM operates as an elastic margin of mineral supply; over time, however, its relationship with industrial mining shifts from complementarity to a reallocation of artisanal activity away from industrial sites. Third, agricultural shocks induce entry into ASM, but spatial labor mobility attenuates local responses, pointing to strong congestion effects. Together, these results position ASM as a central yet spatially constrained adjustment margin in global critical mineral supply.
abstract_zh: 随着能源转型加速对关键矿产的需求，手工和小规模采矿（ASM）已成为重要但认知不足的供应来源。我们通过将监督式深度学习方法应用于卫星图像，构建了首个撒哈拉以南非洲大陆尺度的采矿活动面板数据，识别出39个国家的5万多个采矿点，并重建了2000年至2019年的月度活动数据。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，采矿选址遵循显著的非线性市场可达性梯度——靠近港口在200公里范围内提高采矿概率，但这一优势在中等距离处逆转，仅在偏远地区重新显现，这与远离城市中心反映国家管控薄弱、非正规活动监管较少的情况一致。第二，采矿进入对大宗商品价格冲击反应迅速，表明ASM作为矿产供应的弹性边际发挥作用；但随时间推移，其与工业采矿的关系从互补转向手工活动从工业场地的重新配置。第三，农业冲击促使劳动力进入ASM，但空间劳动力流动削弱了局部响应，表明存在显著的拥挤效应。综合来看，这些结论将ASM定位为全球关键矿产供应中核心但受空间约束的调整边际。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为撒哈拉以南非洲的手工和小规模采矿，数据、制度背景均不涉及中国。
title: Artisanal and Small-Scale Mines in Africa: Where, When and Why
title_zh: 非洲手工与小规模采矿：地点、时间与原因

abstract: We study how partisan newspaper ownership shapes news content, media demand, and policy preferences. Our setting is the 2010 takeover of the Basler Zeitung, a leading Swiss regional daily, by owners affiliated with the conservative Swiss People's Party (SVP), and its 2018 sale to a nonpartisan media group. We combine over three million articles from six German-language Swiss newspapers with municipality-level circulation data and outcomes from 160 federal referendums over twenty years. Using difference-in-differences designs that compare the Basler Zeitung to control-group newspapers and exploit cross-municipality variation in pre-takeover penetration, we trace the effects of ownership along the full chain from content to readership and voting. Partisan ownership shifts coverage toward the SVP platform, especially before referendum votes and on party-sponsored proposals. Circulation declines by 28.8 percent during partisan ownership. Losses are largest in historically left-aligned municipalities, but exposure to the newspaper remains substantial even there. At mean pre-takeover penetration, partisan ownership increases SVP-aligned vote shares by 0.34 percentage points across all referendums, implying a persuasion rate of 14.6 percent among retained, persuadable readers, with larger effects for referendums closely tied to the party platform. Overall, ownership induces both ideological sorting in media demand and persuasion among voters who remain exposed, with political effects concentrated in local environments where SVP positions are more prevalent or less strongly opposed.
abstract_zh: 本文研究党派报纸所有权如何塑造新闻内容、媒体需求及政策偏好。研究背景为2010年瑞士主要地区日报《巴塞尔报》被与保守派瑞士人民党有关联的所有者收购，以及2018年该报被出售给无党派媒体集团。我们整合了六家德语瑞士报纸的三百余万篇文章、市级发行量数据及二十年间160次联邦公投结果。通过双重差分设计（将《巴塞尔报》与对照组报纸比较，并利用收购前渗透率的跨市差异），我们追踪了所有权从内容到读者群再到投票行为的完整影响链条。党派所有权使报道向瑞士人民党纲领倾斜，尤其在公投投票前及政党提案相关议题上。党派所有权期间发行量下降28.8%，历史上左倾市镇的损失最大，但即使在这些地区，报纸曝光度仍保持较高水平。在收购前平均渗透率条件下，党派所有权使所有公投中支持瑞士人民党的投票比例增加0.34个百分点，这意味着在保留的可说服读者中说服率为14.6%，且对与政党纲领紧密相关的公投影响更大。总体而言，所有权既引发媒体需求中的意识形态分化，也对持续接触信息的选民产生说服效应，其政治影响集中于瑞士人民党立场更普遍或反对力度较弱的本地环境。
title: Partisan Media Ownership, News Content, and Policy Preferences
title_zh: 党派媒体所有权、新闻内容与政策偏好

abstract: This paper develops a model where cultural conflict in society and electoral competition are jointly determined. Cultural conservatives and progressives choose, ex ante, their level of tolerance in social relations in response to two sources of threat: the probability of interacting with an intolerant cultural outgroup and the risk of unfavorable cultural policy. Political parties compete on both economic and cultural dimensions. The model shows that as societies gradually shift toward less traditional values, this can, beyond a threshold, trigger endogenous backlash and increased societal intolerance. This backlash shifts political competition from economic to cultural issues, further reinforcing cultural conflict. This two-way interaction can generate multiple equilibria and self-fulfilling “culture wars."
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个模型，将社会中的文化冲突与选举竞争视为内生决定过程。文化保守派与进步派在事前选择其社会关系中的容忍程度，以应对两种威胁来源：与不容忍的文化外群体互动的概率，以及不利文化政策的风险。政党在经济与文化两个维度上展开竞争。模型表明，随着社会逐渐转向非传统价值观，一旦超过某个阈值，便会引发内生性反弹，导致社会不容忍程度加剧。这种反弹将政治竞争从经济议题转向文化议题，进一步强化文化冲突。这种双向互动可能产生多重均衡与自我实现的"文化战争"。
title: Backlash and Culture Wars: A Political Economy Model
title_zh: 反弹与文化战争：一个政治经济学模型

abstract: The alpha male, associated with traditional masculinity features such as competitiveness, assertiveness, and risk tolerance, embodies a biologically grounded dimension of personality. We construct a novel dataset of political leaders' masculinity---measured by facial width-to-height ratio, an established biological marker for traditional masculine behavior driven by testosterone---for more than 2,000 national leaders across 184 countries over 150 years. Leaders’ masculinity has increased over the past 70 years in both democracies and autocracies, across rich and poor countries, and across all regions. Benchmarking against Olympic athletes, Wikipedia-notable individuals, and U.S.\ population data, we document that political leaders exhibit systematically higher masculinity than other groups, in both democracies and autocracies. Leaders' masculinity surges during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, such as the World Wars, the Cold War, and recent decades. Two empirical applications show that masculine leaders are related to democratic change and international war, and these links depend on the institutional environment.
abstract_zh: 阿尔法男性特质，如竞争性、自信和风险承受力，与传统男性气质相关，体现了一种基于生物基础的人格维度。我们构建了一个涵盖150年间184个国家2000多位国家领导人的新型数据集，以面部宽高比（一种由睾酮驱动的传统男性行为的既定生物标志）衡量其男性气质。过去70年间，无论是民主国家还是专制国家、富裕国家还是贫穷国家、以及所有地区，领导人的男性气质均有所上升。通过与奥运运动员、维基百科知名人士及美国人口数据对比，我们发现政治领导人的男性气质在民主和专制国家中均系统性高于其他群体。在地缘政治不确定时期（如两次世界大战、冷战及近几十年），领导人的男性气质显著激增。两项实证研究表明，男性气质与民主变革及国际战争存在关联，且这种关联取决于制度环境。
title: Tha Alpha Politocal Male
title_zh: 阿尔法政治男性

abstract: Accelerating the advancement of new quality productivity (Newprod) has emerged as an essential strategic imperative for nations to navigate global competition and strengthen their capacity for sustainable development. Building on this premise, this study employs data from 280 cities spanning the period from 2009 to 2022 and takes national-level new areas as a representative example to rigorously examine whether location-oriented policy contributes to the advancement of Newprod. The robustness of the findings is verified through multidimensional sensitivity analyses. Empirical results demonstrate that the creation of new areas substantially enhances Newprod, operating through the positive moderating effects of government led technology investment and regional marketization levels. Furthermore, mechanism testing confirms that the policy accelerates Newprod by driving tertiary industry agglomeration while concurrently suppressing traditional manufacturing agglomeration. Further analysis reveals significant structural variations in policy effectiveness. From a spatial configuration standpoint, the single city development model demonstrates superior performance compared to the dual city collaborative model. From an administrative hierarchy perspective, policy impacts are more significant in cities with elevated administrative status.
abstract_zh: 加速发展新质生产力已成为各国应对全球竞争、增强可持续发展能力的重要战略选择。基于此，本研究利用2009—2022年280个城市的面板数据，以国家级新区为典型代表，严谨考察了区位导向型政策是否有助于推动新质生产力发展，并通过多维敏感性分析验证了研究结果的稳健性。实证结果表明，新区的设立显著提升了新质生产力水平，其作用机制在于政府主导的科技投入与区域市场化水平发挥了正向调节效应。进一步机制检验证实，该政策通过驱动第三产业集聚、同时抑制传统制造业集聚的路径加速了新质生产力发展。深入分析发现，政策效应存在显著的结构性差异：从空间布局看，单城发展模式的效果优于双城协同模式；从行政层级看，政策在行政级别较高的城市中影响更为显著。
title: The role of location-oriented policy in promoting the development of new quality productivity in regions
title_zh: 区位导向政策在促进区域新质生产力发展中的作用

abstract: This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。
title: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
title_zh: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段

abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。
title: From field trials to farm adoption: identifying the productivity effect of on-farm technology adoption
title_zh: 从田间试验到农场采纳：识别农场技术采纳的生产率效应

abstract: Recent literature provides evidence of inter-generational correlation regarding gender-stereotypical behavior in the labor market. There are two potential explanations for this pattern: selection and causality. Relying on identification through second moments, we reveal a striking result among female adolescents in Germany and Australia. The apparent positive correlation between mothers and daughters is entirely driven by selection, suggesting that sticky gender norms are responsible for persistent gender segregation in the labor market. Most surprisingly, we find that causality operates in the opposite direction, suggesting that the mother holding a non-stereotypical job may have an ambiguous effect on the daughter’s occupational choice. Our findings have important implications for policymakers and identify new directions for future research. We highlight the need to investigate the mechanisms of transmission further to design policies that are successful at closing the remaining gaps. Our findings also suggest that policies designed to foster balanced gender compositions may fall short of achieving the desired inter-generational spillovers unless fundamental shifts in underlying gender norms occur.
abstract_zh: 近期文献提供了劳动力市场中性别刻板行为代际相关性的证据。这一现象存在两种可能的解释：选择效应与因果效应。通过利用二阶矩识别方法，我们在德国和澳大利亚的女性青少年中揭示了一个惊人结果：母女之间看似正向的相关性完全由选择效应驱动，这表明僵化的性别规范是导致劳动力市场持续性别隔离的根源。最令人意外的是，我们发现因果效应呈现反向作用——母亲从事非刻板职业可能对女儿的择业产生模糊影响。本研究对政策制定具有重要启示，并为未来研究指明了新方向。我们强调需进一步探究传导机制，以设计能有效弥合现存性别差距的政策。研究同时表明，除非根本性转变潜在性别规范，否则旨在促进性别平衡构成的政策可能难以实现预期的代际溢出效应。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Daughters like mothers? New evidence of inter-generational transmission of labor market stereotypical behavior
title_zh: 女儿像母亲？劳动力市场刻板行为代际传递的新证据

abstract: This study develops a common framework to compare the magnitude of national level losses that the COVID-19 pandemic inflicted across three critical dimensions — loss of life, loss of income, and loss of learning — and then explores the global distribution of such losses. To help inform public discussions, the well-being consequences of excess mortality are expressed in years of life lost, while those of income losses and school closures are expressed in additional person-years spent in poverty, either currently or in the future (due to lower growth). While 2020–2021 witnessed a global drop in life expectancy and the largest one-year increase in global poverty in many decades, widespread school closures may cause almost twice as large an increase in future poverty. The estimates of well-being loss for the average global citizen include a loss of 8 days of life, an additional two and half weeks spent in poverty in 2020 and 2021 (17 days), and the possibility of an additional month of life in poverty in the future due to school closures (31 days). The distribution of pandemic costs was highly unequal globally. While aggregating total losses requires the valuation of a year of life lost vis-à-vis an additional year spent in poverty, high-income countries experienced the lowest well-being losses for a wide range of valuations. Aggregate losses were much higher among lower-income countries, especially countries in the Latin America region who suffered the largest mortality costs as well as large losses in learning and sharp increases in poverty.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个统一框架，用以比较新冠疫情在国家层面造成的三重关键维度损失——生命损失、收入损失与学习损失——并进一步探讨此类损失的全球分布格局。为助力公共讨论，超额死亡带来的福祉影响以生命损失年数衡量，而收入损失与学校关闭的后果则通过当前或未来（因增长放缓）新增的贫困人年数呈现。尽管2020-2021年间全球预期寿命下降，且全球贫困人口出现数十年来最大单年增幅，但大规模学校关闭可能使未来贫困人口增幅达到前者的近两倍。全球普通公民的福祉损失估算包括：生命损失8天、2020-2021年额外贫困时间两周半（17天），以及因学校关闭可能导致的未来额外贫困时间一个月（31天）。疫情成本的全球分布极不均衡。尽管汇总总损失需对生命损失年与新增贫困年进行价值权衡，但在广泛的价值评估区间内，高收入国家的福祉损失始终最低。中低收入国家的总损失显著更高，尤以拉丁美洲地区为甚——该地区不仅承受了最高的死亡率成本，还面临严重的学习损失与贫困率急剧攀升。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Lives, livelihoods, and learning: A global perspective on the well-being impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: 生命、生计与学习：新冠疫情对福祉影响的全球视角

abstract: We study compatibility design in repeated procurement. A winning supplier can make a cost-reducing investment that carries over, while compatibility determines how much of the cost reduction is usable by the alternative supplier. Greater compatibility strengthens the alternative supplier but lowers the future value of winning and can weaken investment incentives. We show that when investment is sustainable, optimal compatibility is the lower of the unconstrained buyer-surplus optimum and the investment-sustaining ceiling. Except when zero compatibility is always optimal, buyer-optimal compatibility first rises and then falls with supplier patience.
abstract_zh: 我们研究重复采购中的兼容性设计。获胜供应商可以进行具有延续性的成本削减投资，而兼容性决定了替代供应商能够利用多少成本削减成果。更高的兼容性会增强替代供应商的实力，但会降低未来获胜的价值，并可能削弱投资激励。研究表明，当投资具有可持续性时，最优兼容性取无约束买方剩余最优值与投资可持续上限两者中的较低值。除非零兼容性始终为最优方案，否则买方最优兼容性会随供应商耐心程度先升后降。
title: Compatibility and investment incentives in dynamic procurement
title_zh: 动态采购中的兼容性与投资激励

abstract: The European Union promotes the provision of agri-environment-climate public goods (AECPGs) from agriculture and forestry through dedicated policies. Nevertheless, despite long-term efforts and earmarking of significant financial resources for voluntary agri-environmental schemes, the provision of AECPGs from Europe’s agro-ecosystems is continuing to decline. New governance instruments are urgently required to revert this process. Promising new approaches are seen in novel contract solutions promoting result-based payments, collective implementation, and value-chain-based approaches. However, a deeper understanding of the practical design of these novel schemes is needed to achieve acceptance and successful implementation. We systematically examine real-world examples of contract solutions and their design characteristics by analyzing a dataset of 44 case studies from 13 European countries. Data or information from these case studies was collected using a uniform protocol across countries, and a qualitative content analysis was conducted. Our findings show that result-based approaches differ in their design with regard to measuring environmental performance. Successful result-based approaches enable flexible management, include features for knowledge provision, and are often designed as hybrid solutions to enhance uptake, combining action- and result-based elements. Collective contract solutions are based on a common management agreement of the involved group members, but vary in their degree of formalization, often include a coordinator, and foster meetings and exchanges. Value chain-based solutions differ in terms of the relationship between the production of private goods and the provision of AECPGs, their incentive system, value chain characteristics, and marketing, and often comprise an element of cooperation, also representing a hybrid approach. The findings of this research can help shape the design of such alternative approaches and provide inspiration for promoting the voluntary delivery of AECPGs under the Common Agriculture Policy (CAP) and beyond. abstract_zh: 欧盟通过专项政策推动农业与林业提供农业-环境-气候公共产品（AECPGs）。然而，尽管长期投入大量财政资源用于自愿性农业环境计划，欧洲农业生态系统提供的AECPGs仍在持续减少。亟需新的治理工具来扭转这一趋势。新型合同方案展现出前景，包括推广基于结果的支付、集体实施以及基于价值链的方法。但为获得认可并成功实施，需深入理解这些新型方案的实际设计。我们通过分析来自13个欧洲国家的44个案例数据集，系统考察了合同方案的真实案例及其设计特征。这些案例的数据或信息采用跨国统一协议收集，并进行了定性内容分析。研究结果表明：基于结果的方法在环境绩效衡量设计上存在差异；成功的基于结果方法允许灵活管理，包含知识供给特征，且常设计为结合行动与结果要素的混合方案以提升采纳率。集体合同方案基于参与群体成员的共同管理协议，但正式化程度各异，通常设有协调人，并促进会议与交流。基于价值链的方案在私人物品生产与AECPGs供给的关系、激励机制、价值链特征及营销方式上存在差异，且常包含合作要素，同样体现混合模式。本研究结果有助于塑造此类替代方案的设计，并为在共同农业政策（CAP）及其他框架下促进AECPGs自愿供给提供启示。
title: Design principles for result-based, collective and value chain-based environment and climate contract solutions in agriculture and forestry: Learning from 44 case studies across Europe
title_zh: 农业和林业中基于结果、集体和价值链的环境与气候合同解决方案的设计原则：来自欧洲44个案例研究的经验

abstract: Kumasi’s rapid urbanisation is exerting huge pressure on wetlands and urban green spaces. With increasing urbanisation, land-use changes are on the rise, which are detrimental not only to ecological systems but also to urban resilience. Using the political ecology approach, this paper demonstrates how power relations, governance arrangements, and actor interests interact to shape the dynamics and character of encroachment into ecologically sensitive urban green space. To be more specific, it (i) quantitatively assesses urban expansion-related land-cover change in Kumasi between 1994 and 2024, (ii) analyses the interests and narratives behind the involvement of actors in land use change processes, and (iii) examines how urban governance arrangements mediate these processes. The study employed both quantitative and qualitative methods. The analysis of satellite imagery was performed using Google Earth Pro and ArcMap. Fieldwork entailed a survey of households and officials of relevant institutions. Field verification was conducted using descriptive and regression analyses. The findings showed that the built-up areas have increased from 6.3 sq. km (55.5%) in 1994 to 8.0 sq. km (70.8%) in 2024. Whereas water bodies have declined from 3.7 sq. km (33.0%) in 1994 to 2.3 sq. km. This may still allow for some waterlogging during periods of heavy rainfall. However, the water bodies remain sufficiently large to serve as effective flood buffers. The critical insight is that encroachment is not something passively produced by demographic pressure. Rather, it is the product of governance gaps, uneven regulatory enforcement, and power negotiated among state actors, customary authorities, developers, and residents. The study reflects the reconfiguration of ecological spaces and the reiteration of socio-environmental vulnerability under the regime of governance-mediated urbanisation. The study proposes implementing interventions that integrate governance reform, community engagement, and ecological monitoring systems that combine remote sensing, municipal registries, and community reporting.
abstract_zh: 库马西的快速城市化正对湿地和城市绿地造成巨大压力。随着城市化进程的加快，土地利用变化日益增多，这不仅对生态系统有害，也削弱了城市的韧性。本文采用政治生态学方法，论证权力关系、治理安排和行为者利益如何相互作用，共同塑造生态敏感城市绿地被侵占的动态与特征。具体而言，本文：(i) 定量评估1994年至2024年间库马西与城市扩张相关的土地覆盖变化；(ii) 分析行为者参与土地利用变化过程背后的利益与叙事；(iii) 考察城市治理安排如何调节这些过程。研究采用定量与定性相结合的方法。卫星影像分析使用Google Earth Pro和ArcMap软件进行。实地调查包括对家庭和相关机构官员的问卷调查。实地验证采用描述性分析和回归分析。研究结果显示，建成区面积从1994年的6.3平方公里（55.5%）增加到2024年的8.0平方公里（70.8%），而水体面积则从1994年的3.7平方公里（33.0%）减少至2.3平方公里。这仍可能在强降雨期间导致一定程度的积水，但现有水体规模仍足以充当有效的洪水缓冲带。关键洞察在于，侵占并非由人口压力被动产生，而是治理缺口、监管执行不均以及国家行为者、传统权威、开发商和居民之间权力博弈的产物。本研究反映了在治理中介的城市化体制下，生态空间的重构以及社会-环境脆弱性的再现。研究建议实施整合治理改革、社区参与和生态监测系统的干预措施，该系统应结合遥感技术、市政登记和社区报告。
title: Political ecologies of urban encroachment: Power, governance, and land-use transitions in ecologically sensitive areas of Kumasi, Ghana
title_zh: 城市扩张的政治生态学：加纳库马西生态敏感区的权力、治理与土地利用转型

abstract: Why do so many well-intentioned aid programs in remote areas fail to bring durable outcomes? A common explanation attributes failure to local communities’ lack of knowledge or capacity. This paper argues instead that dependency is embedded in the one-directional structure of aid itself. As an alternative, it introduces a university-community co-practice model that fosters two-way collaboration and integrates external resources into villagers’ everyday practices, through which cognitive, relational, and structural forms of social capital are generated. Drawing on more than five years of action research in two villages in southwestern China, the study shows how universities and villagers collaborated in a paired assistance program to renovate houses and courtyards through hands-on co-practice and mutual learning. These small-scale interventions not only improved living conditions but also enabled villagers to maintain and adapt the initiatives after external experts withdrew. The findings suggest that the university-community partnerships can transform short-term aid into more equitable and resilient rural development by embedding development processes in locally grounded networks of social capital.
abstract_zh: 为什么许多在偏远地区用意良好的援助项目未能带来持久成果？一种常见解释将其归咎于当地社区缺乏知识或能力。本文则认为，依赖性根植于援助本身单向性的结构之中。作为替代方案，本文引入了一种大学与社区共同实践的模型，该模型促进双向合作，并将外部资源融入村民的日常实践中，由此生成认知性、关系性和结构性的社会资本。基于在中国西南两个村庄开展的五年多行动研究，本研究展示了大学与村民如何在结对帮扶项目中通过动手共同实践和相互学习来翻新房屋与庭院。这些小型干预不仅改善了居住条件，还使村民在外部专家撤离后能够维持并调整这些举措。研究结果表明，大学与社区的伙伴关系能够通过将发展过程嵌入基于地方的社会资本网络中，将短期援助转化为更为公平且具有韧性的农村发展。

abstract: We analyze the effects of income interdependence between two players on risk sharing without commitment in an infinitely repeated game. In theory, the likelihood that an informal risk-sharing agreement is self-enforcing decreases with income correlation due to a higher probability of both players being in the same income state in future periods. We test this prediction in a laboratory setting, using treatments with negative, zero, and positive income correlation. Contrary to expectations, we find the least engagement in risk-sharing activities in the zero-correlation treatment. This surprising result suggests that when incomes are positively correlated, experiencing similar financial outcomes fosters a social bond that enhances the success of informal risk-sharing mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了无限重复博弈中，两位参与者之间的收入相互依赖对无承诺风险分担的影响。理论上，由于未来时期两位参与者处于相同收入状态的概率更高，非正式风险分担协议自我执行的可能性会随着收入相关性的增加而降低。我们在实验室环境中检验了这一预测，采用了负相关、零相关和正相关三种收入相关性处理。与预期相反，我们发现零相关处理中风险分担活动的参与度最低。这一令人惊讶的结果表明，当收入呈正相关时，经历相似的财务结果会促进社会纽带，从而增强非正式风险分担机制的成功率。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Income interdependence and informal risk sharing under the shadow of the future
title_zh: 未来阴影下的收入相互依赖与非正式风险分担

abstract: Urban development is perceived as an indicator of economic advancement and opportunity. However, rapid BUA expansion exerts land pressure, acting as a catalyst for land-use and land-cover (LULC) changes. This study examined the role of socio-environmental factors, including landscape types (LTs), geomorphology and topography, in BUA dynamics and LULC changes across urban, peri-urban and rural areas between 1842 and 2019. The spatial analysis for sixty randomly selected study sites (a total of 24,000 ha), located in the Central European region, employed ArcGIS tools, integrating historical cadastral maps (Stable Cadastre, 1842) with CORINE LULC data (2019), and statistical techniques, including Binomial Logistic Regression. Findings revealed that total BUA increased by 84.7%, mainly in warm lowlands, primarily replacing arable land (67.23% of the total LULC changes). The built-up growth encompassed a mixed-sized building ranging from 4 to 32,488 m 2 per unit through infill and edge expansion in urban areas (100–500 m distance from the historical built‑up fabric), and small-sized, clustered (0–50 m distance) BUA expansion around rural settlement cores. The Hot Spot Analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) of recent BUA shows predominant clustering of large-sized buildings in the lowlands, which together account for 33.15%. Population density across 4–11 categories emerged as the most influential predictor. The study demonstrated that the socio-ecological factors act as opportunities (uniform topography of warm lowlands) and constraints (complex topography of cold highlands) for BUA expansion. From a land‑use policy perspective, the study prioritises spatially adaptive, ecologically integrated land‑use governance and restoration strategies in response to accelerating socio‑environmental change.
abstract_zh: 城市发展被视为经济进步与机遇的指标。然而，建成区（BUA）的快速扩张对土地造成压力，成为土地利用与土地覆盖（LULC）变化的催化剂。本研究考察了1842年至2019年间，包括景观类型（LTs）、地貌与地形在内的社会-环境因素在城市、城郊及农村地区的BUA动态与LULC变化中的作用。研究选取中欧地区60个随机样点（总面积24,000公顷），运用ArcGIS工具整合历史地籍图（1842年稳定地籍图）与CORINE LULC数据（2019年），并结合二项逻辑回归等统计方法进行分析。结果显示，BUA总面积增长84.7%，主要集中于温暖低地，其中耕地被替代占LULC总变化的67.23%。建成区扩张包含混合规模建筑（单体面积4至32,488平方米），通过城市区域（距历史建成区100–500米）的填充与边缘扩展，以及农村聚落核心周边小规模、集群式（0–50米距离）BUA扩张实现。近期BUA的热点分析（Getis-Ord Gi*）显示，大型建筑主要聚集于低地，占比达33.15%。人口密度（4–11个类别）成为最具影响力的预测因子。研究表明，社会-生态因素既构成BUA扩张的机遇（温暖低地均匀地形），也形成制约（寒冷高地复杂地形）。从土地利用政策视角，本研究优先提出空间适应性、生态整合的土地利用治理与恢复策略，以应对加速的社会-环境变化。
title: Mapping socio-ecological factors, built-up expansion and land use change: Spatial analysis and insights for planning and restoration
title_zh: 社会生态因素、建成区扩张与土地利用变化的空间分析：规划与修复的启示

abstract: Brazil established its National Policy of Payment for Environmental Services (PES) to promote the maintenance, recovery, and enhancement of ecosystems. Yet the diversity, spatial distribution, and effectiveness of existing initiatives remain poorly understood. This study provides the first nationwide synthesis of all PES programs implemented in Brazil since 2000, based on a systematic scoping review of 80 peer-reviewed papers documenting 138 distinct programs. We apply an analytical framework with 11 dimensions to classify and compare programs by ecosystem type, service category, funding source, objectives, and governance mechanisms. Results show initiatives concentrate in the Atlantic Forest (49.3%) and Cerrado (23.2%) biomes, largely targeting regulation services (93.2%) via forest conservation (65.2%) and restoration (61.6%) actions. Watershed (73.9%) and Forest & Carbon (14.8%) programs predominate; 59.4% of initiatives are in Southeast and 17.4% in North. Most programs rely on public funding (94%), while private and market-based mechanisms remain rare. Despite frequent social objectives (65%) and non-monetary benefits (35%), fiscal dependence and regional imbalance constrain scalability and policy sustainability. By comparing Brazil’s experience with international trends in PES governance, we identify structural challenges to design more adaptive, inclusive, and financially diversified mechanisms that strengthen ecosystem protection and social equity across biomes. Explicitly contrasting Brazil with Latin – American benchmarks, we show that – unlike Costa Rica’s centralized national PES and Mexico’s federally coordinated watershed schemes – Brazil’s policy has fostered a decentralized mosaic of municipal and state programs, closely linked to Forest Code compliance and frequent mixed (cash and in-kind) payments, outlining a distinct regional governance model.
abstract_zh: 巴西建立了国家生态系统服务付费政策，旨在促进生态系统的维护、恢复与增强。然而，现有举措的多样性、空间分布及有效性仍缺乏充分认知。本研究基于对80篇同行评审论文的系统性范围综述（涵盖138个独立项目），首次对2000年以来巴西实施的所有生态系统服务付费项目进行全国性综合梳理。我们运用包含11个维度的分析框架，从生态系统类型、服务类别、资金来源、目标及治理机制等方面对项目进行分类比较。结果显示：项目集中于大西洋森林（49.3%）和塞拉多（23.2%）生物群落，主要通过森林保护（65.2%）和恢复（61.6%）行动瞄准调节服务（93.2%）；流域项目（73.9%）与森林碳汇项目（14.8%）占主导地位；59.4%的举措分布在东南部，17.4%在北部。多数项目依赖公共资金（94%），私营和市场机制仍属罕见。尽管频繁设定社会目标（65%）并提供非货币收益（35%），财政依赖性与区域失衡制约了可扩展性与政策可持续性。通过将巴西经验与国际生态系统服务付费治理趋势对比，我们识别出设计更具适应性、包容性和财务多元化机制的结构性挑战，以强化跨生物群落的生态保护与社会公平。与拉美基准国家的明确对比表明：不同于哥斯达黎加的中央集权式国家生态系统服务付费和墨西哥的联邦协调流域计划，巴西政策催生了分散化的市州级项目拼图，这些项目与《森林法》合规要求紧密关联，并频繁采用混合支付（现金与实物）模式，勾勒出独特的区域治理范式。
title: Payment for environmental services in Brazil: A systematic scoping review of policy design, governance, and territorial patterns
title_zh: 巴西环境服务付费：政策设计、治理与地域格局的系统性范围综述

abstract: When and how to phase out existing regulations represents a critical policy issue for developing countries. This paper investigates the effects of export inspection deregulation, exploiting the removal of China's compulsory inspection regulation for export commodities as a quasi-experiment. We construct a unique firm-level panel dataset comprising 8700 observations by mapping 10-digit HS product codes to firm identifiers and integrating four distinct micro-databases. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we find that deregulating export compulsory inspection exerts an overall positive impact on firm exports, without causing a significant decline in export quality as measured by consumer willingness to pay. We also find that inspection deregulation strengthens firms' innovation capacity, which suggests that innovation could be a mechanism that promotes export performance. Furthermore, we find that the effects of export inspection deregulation are stronger in industries characterized by higher levels of competition. Our findings provide empirical evidence for the benefits of periodic regulatory re-evaluation and suggest that well-designed phase-out mechanisms can foster innovation-led growth in emerging economies.
abstract_zh: 何时以及如何逐步取消现有法规，是发展中国家面临的关键政策问题。本文以中国取消出口商品强制检验规定为准自然实验，探究出口检验放松管制的影响。通过将10位HS编码产品映射至企业标识，并整合四个不同的微观数据库，我们构建了一个包含8700个观测值的独特企业层面面板数据集。运用双重差分（DID）框架，我们发现放松出口强制检验对企业出口整体上产生积极影响，且并未导致以消费者支付意愿衡量的出口质量显著下降。同时，检验放松管制增强了企业的创新能力，这表明创新可能是促进出口绩效的一个机制。此外，我们发现出口检验放松管制在竞争程度较高的行业中效果更为显著。我们的研究为定期重新评估法规的益处提供了经验证据，并表明设计良好的退出机制能够促进新兴经济体的创新驱动型增长。
